I am an economist doing research at the intersection of environmental economics and empirical industrial organization.

I am currently doing a postdoc at the Columbia University Center for Political Economy, and will join the Sciences Po Department of Economics as an Assistant Professor in fall 2026.

I go by Emma, and use she/her pronouns.
